dialogue.origin: はじめまして。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: はじめまして、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Nice to meet you, too. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: 予定時刻に始めさせてもらいます。
dialogue.content: We'll begin now as scheduled.

dialogue.origin: 了解しました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめにご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、40代、女性です。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 相談内容は、二面性のあるママ友について悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I'm troubled by a mom friend who is two-faced.

dialogue.origin: 裏表があるママ友についてですね。具体的にどのようなときに二面性を感じるのか教えていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: So it's about a two-faced mom friend, I see. Could you tell me more specifically about when you sense this two-faced nature?

dialogue.origin: 会っているときは楽しくお話ししているように見えるのに、インスタで陰口を書かれたりします。
dialogue.content: When we meet, it seems like we're having a pleasant conversation, but then she posts comments about me behind my back on Instagram.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね。人間不信になりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That would make anyone lose trust in people.

dialogue.origin: はい、、いわゆる"匂わせ"というみたいですが、
dialogue.content: Yes... I believe it's what they call 'vague-posting,'

dialogue.origin: わたしには了解できず、
dialogue.content: I can't understand it,

dialogue.origin: 意味も分からず、
dialogue.content: I don't understand the meaning,

dialogue.origin: どうしたいのかわかりません、
dialogue.content: and I don't know what she's trying to do.

dialogue.origin: 了解→理解できず、
dialogue.content: *Correction: I mean I can't understand it, not just acknowledge it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。言動が違うと混乱しますよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. It's confusing when someone's words and actions don't match, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: この方と今後どのような関係になっていきたいのですか？例えば関係をきりたいのか？今後も関係を続けなければならないのか？
dialogue.content: What kind of relationship would you like to have with this person going forward? For example, do you want to cut ties, or do you have to continue the relationship?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、子どもの習い事で週3回は会わなくてはいけないので、
dialogue.content: Well... I have to see her three times a week for our children's lessons, so...

dialogue.origin: なるべく穏便に、
dialogue.content: I'd like to keep things as amicable as possible,

dialogue.origin: 適当な距離感を見つけたいと考えていますが、
dialogue.content: and find an appropriate distance,

dialogue.origin: 会えば親しげにしてくるので
dialogue.content: but when we meet, she acts very friendly,

dialogue.origin: むげにもできず、
dialogue.content: so I can't just brush her off,

dialogue.origin: 子どもの手前もありますから、
dialogue.content: and I have our children to consider,

dialogue.origin: 笑ってはいますが、不気味でなりません、
dialogue.content: so while I smile, I can't help but find it creepy.

dialogue.origin: 確かに子供の付き合いがあるから関係きりづらいですよね。こっちも気をつかいすぎて疲れますよね。
dialogue.content: It's certainly difficult to cut ties when your children are involved. It must be exhausting to be so cautious all the time.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 二面性について誰かに相談したりしましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone about her two-faced nature?

dialogue.origin: 最近、わたしと同じ思いをしているママ友さんがいるとわかって、
dialogue.content: Recently, I found out there's another mom friend who feels the same way I do,

dialogue.origin: 少し気持ちは楽になりました、
dialogue.content: and that has made me feel a little better.

dialogue.origin: 誰にでもそうなのかなって、
dialogue.content: I wonder if she's like that with everyone.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと可哀想な人なのかな、
dialogue.content: Maybe she's a bit of a pitiable person,

dialogue.origin: とも思えてきたりして、
dialogue.content: is what I've started to think.

dialogue.origin: どんな心理状態なのかな、と心配にもなります、
dialogue.content: I'm also worried about what her psychological state might be.

dialogue.origin: 確かに同じ気持ちの人がいると楽になりますよね。みんなに陰口を言っているかもしれませんね。相手のことを思いやれるあなたは優しいですね。
dialogue.content: It's certainly a relief to know someone feels the same way. She might be badmouthing everyone. It's kind of you to be able to think about her feelings.

dialogue.origin: どうですかね、、同情⁇なんか優しい気持ちとは違う気がします、
dialogue.content: I'm not sure... Sympathy? It feels a bit different from kindness.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり嫌な思いもさせられているので、
dialogue.content: After all, she has made me feel awful,

dialogue.origin: 優しい気持ちばかりではないです、
dialogue.content: so it's not all kind feelings.

dialogue.origin: 確かに心配にはなりますがあなたが一番嫌な思いをしていますもんね。
dialogue.content: It's true that you worry about her, but you're the one who is being hurt the most by this.

dialogue.origin: 自分が何か悪いことをしたのかな⁇と、
dialogue.content: I wondered if I did something wrong,

dialogue.origin: 考えたこともありますが、、
dialogue.content: I've thought about it, but...

dialogue.origin: 思い当たりません、
dialogue.content: nothing comes to mind.

dialogue.origin: なのになぜ人を不快にさせる投稿をするのでしょうか、
dialogue.content: So why would she post things that make people uncomfortable?

dialogue.origin: 表面上は楽しいそうに話すから自分が気にさわるようなことをしてないか悩んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: Because she acts so cheerful on the surface, it makes you worry that you might have done something to offend her, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相手の考えがわからないから不快にさせる投稿をしている意図をつかむのは難しいですよね。
dialogue.content: Since you don't know her thoughts, it's hard to grasp the intent behind her uncomfortable posts, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは二面性の部分が見えないければ少し楽になりますか？
dialogue.content: Would it make things a bit easier for you if you didn't have to see her two-faced side?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、
dialogue.content: I suppose so...

dialogue.origin: インスタを見るまでは気付きませんでした
dialogue.content: I didn't notice until I saw her Instagram

dialogue.origin: 二面性があることに
dialogue.content: that she was two-faced.

dialogue.origin: 確かに投稿見ないと気づきませんよね。いつもは楽しそうにしているから
dialogue.content: That's true, you wouldn't notice if you didn't see her posts, since she always seems so cheerful.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相手の投稿をみないようにすることはできないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it possible for you to avoid looking at her posts?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、最近はもう見るのも怖くてあまり見てないです、
dialogue.content: Well... lately I've been too scared to look, so I haven't been looking much.

dialogue.origin: ただもう二面性を知ってしまって、
dialogue.content: But now that I know about her two-faced nature,

dialogue.origin: 以前のような関係になることは望みません、
dialogue.content: I don't want the relationship to go back to what it was before.

dialogue.origin: 関係は戻りにくいですよね。信用もできないし
dialogue.content: It's hard to go back, isn't it? You can't trust her anymore.

dialogue.origin: はい、無理ですね、
dialogue.content: Yes, it's impossible.

dialogue.origin: ママ友も同じ気持ちだと思いますがどのように対応しているとか聞きましたか？
dialogue.content: I imagine the other mom friend feels the same way. Have you asked her how she's handling it?

dialogue.origin: 彼女はしばらく距離を置いているといっていました、
dialogue.content: She said she's been keeping her distance for a while,

dialogue.origin: でもわたしは週3回会うので
dialogue.content: but I see her three times a week,

dialogue.origin: なかなか難しいです、
dialogue.content: so that's quite difficult for me.

dialogue.origin: 確かに3回も会うなら距離はおけないですよね。
dialogue.content: Indeed, if you see her three times a week, it's hard to keep your distance.

dialogue.origin: わたしさえやり過ごせばいいのか、と思いましたが、
dialogue.content: I thought maybe I should just try to get through it,

dialogue.origin: なんか違う気もして、
dialogue.content: but that doesn't feel right either.

dialogue.origin: 疲れてしまうし、
dialogue.content: It's exhausting,

dialogue.origin: 不健康だし、
dialogue.content: and it's unhealthy.

dialogue.origin: 不健康→不健全
dialogue.content: Unhealthy—I mean, dysfunctional.

dialogue.origin: 自分だけやりすごそうと考えいたら他に人にも被害がでると考えると難しいですよね。
dialogue.content: It's difficult when you think that if you just endure it, other people might get hurt too.

dialogue.origin: いろいろ考えると精神的にも疲れるし
dialogue.content: And thinking about all this is mentally exhausting.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 他に周りで相談をできる方はいないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone else around you that you can talk to about this?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、他か唯一、主人には話せます、
dialogue.content: Let's see... The only other person I can talk to is my husband.

dialogue.origin: あまり周りに言ってしまうと、
dialogue.content: If I tell too many people around me,

dialogue.origin: わたしが悪口をいう話になりかねませんから、
dialogue.content: it could end up sounding like I'm the one badmouthing her.

dialogue.origin: 確かに変な噂がたつのも嫌ですよね。夫さんに一度ご相談してみてはいかがでしょうか？少しらくになるかもしれませんよ。
dialogue.content: That's true, you wouldn't want strange rumors spreading. How about trying to discuss it with your husband? You might feel a little better.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね、
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right.

dialogue.origin: また機会を見つけて相談してみます、
dialogue.content: I'll find a chance to talk to him about it.

dialogue.origin: それがいいと思います。勇気がいると思いますが頑張ってみてください。
dialogue.content: I think that's a good idea. It might take courage, but please give it a try.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 他に質問はございますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any other questions?

dialogue.origin: 質問はないです、
dialogue.content: No, I don't have any questions.

dialogue.origin: それでは、本日のご相談はここで終了とさせていただきます。お時間を作ってお話をお聞かせいただき、どうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: In that case, we will conclude today's session here. Thank you very much for your time and for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: ママ友との二面性に関する問題
